headline: Exchange Flow Reverses To A 256.5 Million Dollar Outflow From A 208.4 Million Dollar Inflow
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, reversed to a 256.5 million dollar net outflow, 0.0953 percent of custodied value, from a 208.4 million dollar inflow and 0.0773 percent on the prior print. Binance sent out 264.7 million dollars while Bitstamp took in 239.3 million dollars, so the largest venue is releasing dollars as another is still receiving them. A negative print means dollars left the venues where holders can sell, and a positive print means dollars arrived there.
author: jordan
